name: update_ehr_access
description: update_ehr_access: Update a provider's EHR system access permissions following privilege reactivation.

case_id.description: The privilege reactivation case ID. Format: CASE-PRV-6digits. Example: CASE-PRV-048271

access_change_type.description: The EHR access level to restore: reactivate_full (all modules and patient records) or reactivate_restricted (limited read-only access)
